briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This hour, we have identified several key developments related to fraud in Minnesota. A Somali scammer was convicted of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota's largest-ever case. Additionally, DHS has been handing out bonuses to staff in charge of a fraud-riddled program. These findings indicate a potential pattern of fraud within the program and highlight the need for increased scrutiny. We are tracking these cases closely and will continue to investigate. Next steps include analyzing the data from DHS and following the money trail in the Medicaid fraud case.
